note: The sign-in screen (art/reference/auth.png). The painting fills the screen with its foot on the screen's foot; the panel's contents are separate crops so the screen can lay them out -- closed up while the Apple slot is hidden, and lifted as one over a phone's keyboard.

crops.name: auth/page
crops.note: the whole sign-in painting: the castle, EMPERORS, the panel with ENTER THE REALM and TERMS - PRIVACY baked. Everything between the title and TERMS -- the two fields, SIGN IN, CREATE ACCOUNT, OR and the empty Sign in with Apple plate -- is lifted row by row from the panel's own plain ground (x 94-106): each is its own crop, drawn where the screen puts it, so the panel can close up while the Apple slot waits for Wave 2.

crops.name: auth/field_user
crops.note: the username box with its quill; the LineEdit draws no plate

crops.name: auth/field_pass
crops.note: the password box with its key

crops.name: auth/or
crops.note: OR, over the Apple slot: hidden until Sign in with Apple (Wave 2)

crops.name: auth/apple_slot
crops.note: the empty plate Sign in with Apple goes in (Wave 2)
